conventions.figure_summary: Median of available non-null ratings within each dimension, with minimum, maximum, range, and n/3. Incomplete figures are retained with an explicit partial label.
conventions.group_summary: Each available figure median contributes once, regardless of how many non-null repeats it has. Means are descriptive averages of ordinal-scale ratings, not a composite quality score.
conventions.repeat_range: Max minus min of non-null repeat scores. Distribution n2plus excludes figures with fewer than two valid scores; n3 additionally requires three valid scores.
conventions.units: Figures and unique papers, not model requests. Paper counts within groups are not additive when a paper contributes both roles.
conventions.separation: Main stage × role groups and the purposely selected style × role groups are reported separately.
conventions.limits: Single-model descriptive evaluation only. No inter-model agreement, human-preference claims, significance tests, causal interpretation of stage, or inference of actual production tools.
